👍👎 Pros & Cons

✅ Pros

  • + Truly autonomous execution — no step-by-step guidance needed
  • + Free plan available without credit card
  • + Strong performance on GAIA benchmark
  • + Multi-platform support for task delegation anywhere
  • + Can build web apps with payment and database integration

❌ Cons

  • - Credit consumption not transparent — no cost estimate before running tasks
  • - Complex tasks may consume 3-5x more credits than expected
  • - Free plan limited to Lite model only
  • - Monthly credits do not roll over
  • - Enterprise compliance (SOC 2/GDPR) still incomplete

🎯 Key Features

Autonomous multi-step task planning and execution Cloud-based virtual browser environment Code writing and real-time execution Deep research and information gathering Web application development Data analysis and visualization AI slide deck generation Multi-platform access (Web/Desktop/Telegram/WhatsApp/Slack)

💡 Tips & Tricks

  • 1 Use daily 300 refresh credits first before touching your monthly pool
  • 2 Break complex tasks into smaller ones for lower credit consumption
  • 3 Use ChatGPT for simple Q&A — Manus shines on autonomous multi-step tasks
  • 4 Annual billing saves 17% — Standard plan is ~$200/year
